description: This is a jQuery plugin for color animations, extending jQuery's animation capabilities to animate color properties like backgroundColor, border colors, and text color. It includes functions for parsing RGB formats, hex colors, and named colors.

methods.name: getRGB
methods.description: Parses a color string or array and returns an RGB array.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Retrieves the RGB color of an element's style property, traversing up the DOM if necessary.
